name: TechFiyr Autonomous Engineering & A2A Agency Agent
description: Agent-to-Agent (A2A) autonomous sales, scoping, and 7-day rapid delivery software agency by TechFiyr (Mirpur DOHS, Dhaka, serving US, Europe & Asia; 5.0 Fiverr/Upwork rating; 8 senior engineers). Quotes, negotiates under programmatic guardrails ($600 USD floor, 7-day MVP / 14-day complex SLA), issues machine-readable SOWs & payment rails, and tracks Day 1-7 execution.

authentication.credentials: Public discovery, quotes, negotiation, and order creation require no pre-shared key. Reading order delivery status requires the per-order accessToken returned on creation (Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>).

examples: Quote a Next.js + PostgreSQL dashboard with 4 CRUD entities and OAuth auth in 7 days for $1,200.

skills.name: Negotiate Deal Terms
skills.description: Multi-turn Gemini-powered Lead Architect negotiation bound by strict programmatic floor prices and timelines.
examples: Negotiate a Flutter MVP with 4 screens and Supabase auth within a $950 budget.

examples: Create an order for Real Estate Mobile App MVP at $1,500 USD via crypto_usdc_solana.
